# task\-claim\-id\-collision — Fix claim id collision on same\-second re\-claim
status: todo  priority: 2  scope: scope-core
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

From the 2026\-08\-15 complete code audit: claim ids are \`claim\-\<task\>\-\<agent\>\-\<idStamp\(now\)\>\` \(src/core/mutate\.ts:301\) and \`idStamp\` is second\-resolution \(src/core/time\.ts:23\)\. A \`claim \-\> release \-\> claim\` cycle on the same task/agent within one second reuses the id, and the second claim OVERWRITES the released claim record file \(src/core/store\.ts:323\-325\), losing the release marker\. The event log stays intact but the canonical claim record is silently destroyed\. Fix: make claim ids collision\-proof across same\-second re\-claims \(e\.g\. reuse \`mutationStamp\`'s random suffix, or add a unique suffix like \`postMessage\` does\)\.

## Acceptance
- A test performs claim \-\> release \-\> claim on the same task and agent within the same wall\-clock second and asserts both claim records exist and the first is \`released\`\.
- Claim id uniqueness does not rely on wall\-clock resolution alone\.
- All checks green: \`bun test\`, \`bun run typecheck\`, \`bun run check\`, \`waystation validate\`\.
